name: 07-turn-outcomes
description: How a turn ends: a caller outcome stays, an error sets error and the span status, an AbortError sets aborted, and an invalid outcome, timing or token count is dropped and named in flywheel.attribute_error.
covers: practice 1: an error inside the turn sets the outcome to error, the span status to ERROR, records the exception, and is rethrown
practice 1: an AbortError inside the turn sets the outcome to aborted
practice 1: an outcome outside the enum, or a timing or token count of the wrong type, is dropped and named in flywheel.attribute_error
practice 1: with no conversation id, the turn span has no gen_ai.conversation.id
practice 1: with no messages, there is no app.turn.messages, the message count is 0 and tool_called is false
practice 1: a caller toolCalled stays, and record.timings and record.usage replace the timeline values
